verses.geez: ረከቡኒ፡ እለ፡ ኢኀሠሡኒ፡ ወአስተርአይክዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ኢተስእሉኒ።
verses.translation: I became manifest to them that asked not for me; I was found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold, I am here, to a nation, who called not on my name.

translations.lxx: I became manifest to them that asked not for me; I was found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold, I am here, to a nation, who called not on my name.
translations.kjv: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
translations.ron: Căutat am fost de cei ce nu întrebau de Mine, găsit am fost de cei ce nu Mă căutau. Şi am zis: "Iată-Mă, iată-Mă aici, la un neam care nu chema numele Meu!

verses.geez: ኵሎ፡ አሚረ፡ እሰፍሕ፡ እደውየ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ዓላውያን፡ ወከሐድያን፣፡ እለ፡ ኢሖሩ፡ በፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወተለዉ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ።
verses.translation: I have stretched forth my hands all day to a disobedient and gainsaying people, to them that walked in a way that was not good, but after their sins.

translations.lxx: I have stretched forth my hands all day to a disobedient and gainsaying people, to them that walked in a way that was not good, but after their sins.
translations.kjv: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
translations.ron: Tins-am mâinile Mele în toată vremea către un popor răzvrătit, care mergea pe căi silnice, după cugetele sale,

verses.geez: ዝንቱኬ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዘአምፅዑኒ፡ ወትረ።
verses.translation: This is the people that provokes me continually in my presence; they offer sacrifices in gardens, and burn incense on bricks to devils, which exist not.

translations.lxx: This is the people that provokes me continually in my presence; they offer sacrifices in gardens, and burn incense on bricks to devils, which exist not.
translations.kjv: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
translations.ron: Oameni care întărâtau fără încetare faţa Mea jertfind în grădini şi pe lespezile acoperişului ardeau miresme;

verses.geez: ይትኔወሙ፡ ውስተ፡ በአታት፡ ሐላምያን፣፡ ወይበልዑ፡ ሥጋ፡ ሐራውያ፡ ወያረኵሱ፡ ደመ፡ መሥዋዕቶሙ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ንዋዮሙ።
verses.translation: They lie down to sleep in the tombs and in the caves for the sake of dreams, even they that eat swine's flesh, and the broth of their sacrifices: all their vessels are defiled:

translations.lxx: They lie down to sleep in the tombs and in the caves for the sake of dreams, even they that eat swine's flesh, and the broth of their sacrifices: all their vessels are defiled:
translations.kjv: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
translations.ron: Stăteau în morminte şi mâncau în crăpături de stâncă, mâncau carne de porc, ale căror vase erau pline de mâncăruri spurcate

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይብሉ፤ ረኀቕ፡ እምኔየ፡ ወኢትቅረበኒ፡ እስመ፡ ንጹሕ፡ አነ።
verses.translation: who say, Depart from me, draw not nigh to me, for I am pure. This is the smoke of my wrath, a fire burns with it continually.

translations.lxx: who say, Depart from me, draw not nigh to me, for I am pure. This is the smoke of my wrath, a fire burns with it continually.
translations.kjv: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
translations.ron: Şi care ziceau: "Dă-te înapoi, nu te apropia de mine, căci eu sunt sfânt faţă de tine!" - Aceştia sunt ca un fum care se urcă în nările Mele, o văpaie care arde fără sfârşit.

verses.geez: ናሁ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ቅድሜየ፤ ወኢያረምም፡ እስከ፡ እፈዲ፡ ወእትቤቀል፡ ወአገብእ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ሕፅኖሙ።
verses.translation: Behold, it is written before me: I will not be silent until I have recompensed into their bosom,

translations.lxx: Behold, it is written before me: I will not be silent until I have recompensed into their bosom,
translations.kjv: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
translations.ron: Iată este scris înaintea Mea: "Nu voi tăcea până ce nu voi răsplăti

verses.geez: ኃጢአቶሙ፡ ወዘአበዊሆሙ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: their sins and the sins of their fathers, saith the Lord, who have burnt incense on the mountains, and reproached me on the hills: I will recompense their works into their bosom.

translations.lxx: their sins and the sins of their fathers, saith the Lord, who have burnt incense on the mountains, and reproached me on the hills: I will recompense their works into their bosom.
translations.kjv: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
translations.ron: Fărădelegile voastre şi fărădelegile părinţilor voştri laolaltă, - zice Domnul - ale celor care au adus jertfă de tămâie pe munţi şi pe dealuri şi au râs de Mine. Eu îi voi răsplăti după faptele lor şi cu măsură plină.

verses.geez: ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ በከመ፡ ይትረከብ፡ ሕንባበ፡ ወይን፡ ውስተ፡ አስካል፡ ወይብሉ፤ ኢታጥፍኦ፡ እስመ፡ በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ከመዝ፡ እገብር፡ በእንተ፡ ዘተቀንየ፡ ሊተ፡ በበይነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያጥፍእ።
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord, As a grape-stone shall be found in the cluster, and they shall say, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for the sake of him that serves me, for his sake I will not destroy them all.

translations.lxx: Thus saith the Lord, As a grape-stone shall be found in the cluster, and they shall say, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for the sake of him that serves me, for his sake I will not destroy them all.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
translations.ron: Aşa zice Domnul: "Ca atunci când găseşti must într-un strugure şi zici: "Nu-l rupe, că în acesta se află o binecuvântare", tot astfel voi face şi cu slujitorii Mei; Mă voi feri să stric tot!

verses.geez: ወአመጽእ፡ ዘርአ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወዘርአ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ወይወርሱ፡ ደብረ፡ መቅደስየ፣፡ ወይወርሱ፡ ኅሩያንየ፡ ወአግብርትየ፡ ወይነብሩ፡ ህየ።
verses.translation: And I will lead forth the seed that came of Jacob and of Juda, and they shall inherit my holy mountain: and mine elect and my servants shall inherit it, and shall dwell there.

translations.lxx: And I will lead forth the seed that came of Jacob and of Juda, and they shall inherit my holy mountain: and mine elect and my servants shall inherit it, and shall dwell there.
translations.kjv: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
translations.ron: Şi voi face să răsară din Iacov o odraslă şi din Iuda un moştenitor peste munţii Mei; şi cei aleşi ai Mei li vor stăpâni şi slujitorii Mei vor locui acolo.

verses.geez: ወየኀድሩ፡ ማእከለ፡ ዖም፡ ወአዕፃዳተ፡ መራዕይ፡ ወውስተ፡ ቈላተ፡ አኮር፡ አዕፃዳተ፡ ወፍር፡ ዘሕዝብየ፡ እለ፡ ኀሠሡኒ።
verses.translation: And there shall be in the forest folds of flocks, and the valley of Achor shall be for a resting-place of herds for my people, who have sought me.

translations.lxx: And there shall be in the forest folds of flocks, and the valley of Achor shall be for a resting-place of herds for my people, who have sought me.
translations.kjv: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
translations.ron: Şi Şaronul va ajunge păşune pentru turme şi Acorul, imaş pentru vite, pentru poporul Meu care M-a căutat pe Mine.

verses.geez: አንትሙሰ፡ እለ፡ ኀደግሙኒ፡ ወረሳዕክሙ፡ ደብረ፡ መቅደስየ፡ ወትሠርዑ፡ ማእደ፡ ለአጋንንት፡ ወትቀድሑ፡ ለበፃውዕ፡ ወትመልኡ።
verses.translation: But ye are they that have left me, and forget my holy mountain, and prepare a table for the devil, and fill up the drink-offering to Fortune.

translations.lxx: But ye are they that have left me, and forget my holy mountain, and prepare a table for the devil, and fill up the drink-offering to Fortune.
translations.kjv: But ye are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
translations.ron: Şi voi, cei ce aţi părăsit pe Domnul, care aţi uitat de muntele Meu cel sfânt, care întindeţi masă pentru dumnezeul Gad şi umpleţi o cupă pentru Meni;

verses.geez: ወአነ፡ እሜጥወክሙ፡ ለኵናት፡ ወትመውቱ፡ ኵልክሙ፡ በመጥባሕት፤ እስመ፡ ጸዋዕኩክሙ፡ ወኢያውሣእክሙኒ፤ ወነበብከኩክሙ፡ ወተፀመምክሙኒ፣፡ ወገበርክሙ፡ እኩየ፡ በቅድሜየ፡ ወኢፈቀድክሙ፡ አድኅንክሙ።
verses.translation: I will deliver you up to the sword, ye shall all fall by slaughter: for I called you, and ye hearkened not; I spoke, and ye refused to hear; and ye did evil in my sight, and chose the things wherein I delighted not.

translations.lxx: I will deliver you up to the sword, ye shall all fall by slaughter: for I called you, and ye hearkened not; I spoke, and ye refused to hear; and ye did evil in my sight, and chose the things wherein I delighted not.
translations.kjv: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
translations.ron: Pe toţi vă voi da în ascuţişul sabiei şi junghierii vă veţi pleca, pentru că am strigat către voi şi nu Mi-aţi răspuns, am grăit şi nu M-aţi auzit, ci aţi făcut cele rele în ochii Mei şi ceea ce nu am binevoit aţi ales".

verses.geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ እለ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ሊተ፡ ይበልዑ፣፡ ወአንትሙሰ፡ ትርኅቡ፤ እለ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ሊተ፡ ይሰትዩ፣፡ ወአንትሙሰ፡ ትጸምኡ፤ እለ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ሊተ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ ወአንትሙሰ፡ ተኀሥሩ።
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall hunger: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall thirst: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

translations.lxx: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall hunger: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall thirst: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
translations.ron: Pentru aceasta, aşa zice Domnul Dumnezeu: "Iată, slugile Mele vor mânca şi vouă vă va fi foame, vor bea şi voi veţi fi însetaţi, se vor bucura, iar voi veţi fi înfruntaţi!

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ሊተ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ በኃሤት፣፡ ወአንትሙሰ፡ ትግዕሩ፡ በሕማመ፡ ልብክሙ፤ ወበቅጥቃጤ፡ ነፍስክሙ፡ ተአወይዉ።
verses.translation: behold, my servants shall exult with joy, but ye shall cry for the sorrow of your heart, and shall howl for the vexation of your spirit.

translations.lxx: behold, my servants shall exult with joy, but ye shall cry for the sorrow of your heart, and shall howl for the vexation of your spirit.
translations.kjv: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
translations.ron: Iată slugile Mele vor sălta de veselie, iar voi veţi striga de întristată ce vă va fi inima, şi de frânt ce vă va fi sufletul veţi urla!"

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ኀደግሙ፡ ስመክሙ፡ ወተጸገብክምዎሙ፡ ለኅሩያንየ፣፡ ወለክሙሰ፡ ያጠፍአክሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ ወይሰመይ፡ ስመ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ለእለ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ ሊተ።
verses.translation: For ye shall leave your name for a loathing to my chosen, and the Lord shall destroy you: but my servants shall be called by a new name,

translations.lxx: For ye shall leave your name for a loathing to my chosen, and the Lord shall destroy you: but my servants shall be called by a new name,
translations.kjv: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
translations.ron: Şi veţi lăsa numele vostru aleşilor Mei spre blestem: "Domnul Dumnezeu să te ucidă!... Dar slujitorii Mei vor fi numiţi cu alt nume.

verses.geez: ወይትባረኩ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፤ እስመ፡ ይባርክዎ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ጽድቅ፤ ወዘይምሕሉ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡ በአምላከ፡ ጽድቅ።
verses.translation: which shall be blessed on the earth; for they shall bless the true God: and they that swear upon the earth shall swear by the true God; for they shall forget the former affliction, and it shall not come into their mind.

translations.lxx: which shall be blessed on the earth; for they shall bless the true God: and they that swear upon the earth shall swear by the true God; for they shall forget the former affliction, and it shall not come into their mind.
translations.kjv: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
translations.ron: Cine se va binecuvânta pe pământ se va binecuvânta de Dumnezeul adevărului, şi cel ce se va jura pe pământ se va jura pe Dumnezeul adevărului; că nenorocirile din vremurile de demult au fost uitate şi ei stau departe de ochii Mei.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ይከውን፡ ሰማይ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወምድርኒ፡ ሐዳሰ፤ ወኢይዜከሩ፡ እንከ፡ ዘቀዲሙ፡ ወኢይመጽኦሙ፡ በልቦሙ።
verses.translation: For there shall be a new heaven and a new earth: and they shall not at all remember the former, neither shall they at all come into their mind.

translations.lxx: For there shall be a new heaven and a new earth: and they shall not at all remember the former, neither shall they at all come into their mind.
translations.kjv: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
translations.ron: Pentru că Eu voi face ceruri noi şi pământ nou. Nimeni nu-şi va mai aduce aminte de vremurile trecute şi nimănui nu-i vor mai veni în minte,

verses.geez: ዳእሙ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ወኃሤተ፡ ይረክቡ፡ በውስቴታ፤ ወአነኒ፡ እገብር፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ወኃሤተ፡ በኀበ፡ ሕዝብየ።
verses.translation: But they shall find in her joy and exultation; for, behold, I make Jerusalem a rejoicing, and my people a joy.

translations.lxx: But they shall find in her joy and exultation; for, behold, I make Jerusalem a rejoicing, and my people a joy.
translations.kjv: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
translations.ron: Ci se vor bucura şi se vor veseli de ceea ce Eu voi fi făcut, căci iată întemeiez Ierusalimul pentru bucurie şi poporul lui pentru desfătare.

verses.geez: ወእትኀሠይ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወእትፌሣሕ፡ በሕዝብየ፤ ወኢይሰማዕ፡ እንከ፡ በውስቴታ፡ ቃለ፡ ብካይ፡ ወቃለ፡ አውያት።
verses.translation: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and will be glad in my people: and there shall no more be heard in her the voice of weeping, or the voice of crying.

translations.lxx: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and will be glad in my people: and there shall no more be heard in her the voice of weeping, or the voice of crying.
translations.kjv: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
translations.ron: Şi Mă voi bucura de Ierusalim şi Mă voi veseli de poporul Meu şi nu se va mai auzi în acesta nici plâns, nici ţipăt.

verses.geez: ወኢይሄሉ፡ እንከ፡ ሕፃን፡ ዘኅዳጥ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወረሢእ፡ ዘኢያብጽሐ፡ ጊዜሁ።
verses.translation: Neither shall there be there any more a child that dies untimely, or an old man who shall not complete his time: for the youth shall be a hundred years old, and the sinner who dies at a hundred years shall also be accursed:

translations.lxx: Neither shall there be there any more a child that dies untimely, or an old man who shall not complete his time: for the youth shall be a hundred years old, and the sinner who dies at a hundred years shall also be accursed:
translations.kjv: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
translations.ron: Să nu mai fie acolo copii care mor în floarea vârstei şi nici bătrâni care nu ajung la capătul vieţii lor! Aşa că cine va muri la o sută de ani va fi tânăr şi cine nu o va ajunge va fi blestemat.

verses.geez: ወየሐንጹ፡ አብያተ፡ ወይነብሩ፡ ውስቴቶን፤ ወይተክሉ፡ ወይነ፡ ወይበልዑ፡ ቀምሖ።
verses.translation: and they shall build houses, and themselves shall dwell in them; and they shall plant vineyards, and themselves shall eat the fruit thereof.

translations.lxx: and they shall build houses, and themselves shall dwell in them; and they shall plant vineyards, and themselves shall eat the fruit thereof.
translations.kjv: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
translations.ron: Şi ei vor zidi case şi vor locui şi vor sădi vii şi din rodul lor vor mânca.

verses.geez: ወኢየሐንጹ፡ ወይነብሩ፡ ባዕዳን፣፡ ወኢይተክሉ፡ ወይበልዑ፡ ባዕዳን፤ ወይከውን፤ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ከመ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፤ ወይረሥኡ፡ ኅሩያንየ፡ ውስተ፡ ተግባተ፡ እደዊሆሙ።
verses.translation: They shall by no means build, and others inhabit; and they shall by no means plant, and others eat: for as the days of the tree of life shall be the days of my people, they shall long enjoy the fruits of their labours.

translations.lxx: They shall by no means build, and others inhabit; and they shall by no means plant, and others eat: for as the days of the tree of life shall be the days of my people, they shall long enjoy the fruits of their labours.
translations.kjv: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
translations.ron: Dar nu vor clădi ca altul să locuiască, nici nu vor sădi ca altul să mănânce. Într-adevăr vârsta poporului Meu va fi ca vârsta copacilor, şi cei aleşi ai Mei se vor bucura de osteneala mâinilor lor.

verses.geez: ወኢይፃምዉ፡ እንከ፡ ለከንቱ፡ ወኢይወልዱ፡ ለመርገም፣፡ እስመ፡ ዘርአ፡ ብሩክ፡ ዘእምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወውሉዶሙ፡ ምስሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: My chosen shall not toil in vain, neither shall they beget children to be cursed; for they are a seed blessed of God, and their offspring with them.

translations.lxx: My chosen shall not toil in vain, neither shall they beget children to be cursed; for they are a seed blessed of God, and their offspring with them.
translations.kjv: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.
translations.ron: Nu se vor trudi în zadar şi nu vor naşte feciori pentru moarte fără de vreme, că ei vor fi un neam binecuvântat de Domnul şi împreună cu ei şi odraslele lor.

verses.geez: ወዘእንበለ፡ ይኬልሑ፡ እሠጠዎሙ፡ አነ፤ ወእንዘሂ፡ ይነበቡ፡ እብሎሙ፤ ነዋ፡ ሀለውኩ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will hearken to them; while they are yet speaking, I will say, What is it?

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will hearken to them; while they are yet speaking, I will say, What is it?
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
translations.ron: Şi înainte de a Mă chema pe Mine, Eu le voi răspunde, şi grăind ei încă, Eu îi voi fi ascultat.

verses.geez: ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ተኵላት፡ ወአባግዕ፡ ይትረዐዩ፡ ኅቡረ፣፡ ወአንበሳሂ፡ ከመ፡ ላህም፡ ሣዕረ፡ ይቀምሕ፡ ወሲሳየ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ሐመድ፤ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነክዩ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘያሐሥም፡ በደብረ፡ መቅደስየ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Then wolves and lambs shall feed together, and the lion shall eat chaff like the ox, and the serpent earth as bread. They shall not injure nor destroy in my holy mountain, saith the Lord.

translations.lxx: Then wolves and lambs shall feed together, and the lion shall eat chaff like the ox, and the serpent earth as bread. They shall not injure nor destroy in my holy mountain, saith the Lord.
translations.kjv: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
translations.ron: Lupul va paşte la un loc cu mielul, leul va mânca paie ca boul şi şarpele cu ţărână se va hrăni. Nimic rău şi vătămător nu va fi în muntele Meu cel sfânt", zice Domnul.
